import subprocess,concurrent.futures,json
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/tmp/hexalith-dw517-20261014/mutations')
def run(name):
 cwd=str(base/name);commands=[['dotnet','build','Mutation.csproj','--configuration','Release','-warnaserror','-m:1','-nr:false'],['dotnet','bin/Release/net10.0/Mutation.dll','-method','Hexalith.EventStore.Server.Tests.Security.SecretsProtectionTests.EvidenceFileIngestion_*','-noLogo']]
 codes=[]
 for phase,cmd in zip(['build','tests'],commands):
  p=subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/dw517-run.py','mutation-'+name+'-'+phase,cwd,*cmd],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,text=True);codes.append(p.returncode)
  if phase=='build' and p.returncode!=0:print(p.stdout);break
 print(name,codes,flush=True);return name,codes

 results=dict(ex.map(run,['control','ingestion-bypass','scanning-bypass','retirement-content-bypass','retirement-approval-bypass','seal-bypass']))
assert results['control']==[0,0]
assert all(v[0]==0 and v[1]!=0 for k,v in results.items() if k!='control')

changed('ingestion-bypass',main,'if (IsRetiredEvidenceCapture(path, root) || IsExplicitGeneratedPath(path))','if (RestoredEvidencePaths.Contains(path, StringComparer.Ordinal) || IsRetiredEvidenceCapture(path, root) || IsExplicitGeneratedPath(path))')
changed('scanning-bypass',main,'? FindViolations(path, content)\n            : [];','? []\n            : [];')

changed('retirement-approval-bypass',main,approval[0],'')
changed('seal-bypass',main,'VerifySealedP1RRemediationSourceCapture(File.ReadAllBytes(Path.Combine(root, path)));','_ = root;')
changed('interpolation-boundary-bypass',recognition,"return afterField == body.Length || body.Value[afterField] is ' ' or '\\t' or ';';",'return true;')
changed('probe-verification-bypass',recognition,'IsInPythonUnitTestClass(content, position, rejection)','true')
changed('here-document-ownership-bypass',recognition,'if (!opening.Success) { return []; }','if (!opening.Success) { cursor = end + 1; continue; }')
variant=dict(sources)
assert variant[main].count('content = MaskBoundedPythonSecurityProbes(relativePath, content);')==1
assert variant[main].count('!IsBoundedPythonSourceAssignment(effectivePath, content, match)')==1
variant[main]=variant[main].replace('content = MaskBoundedPythonSecurityProbes(relativePath, content);','_ = relativePath;').replace('!IsBoundedPythonSourceAssignment(effectivePath, content, match)','true')
variants['recognition-disabled']=variant
project='''<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk"><PropertyGroup><TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework><OutputType>Exe</OutputType><Nullable>enable</Nullable><ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings><EnableNETAnalyzers>false</EnableNETAnalyzers><LangVersion>14.0</LangVersion><NoWarn>IDE0028;CA2007;xUnit1051;CS0618;CS8602;CS8604;CS8600</NoWarn></PropertyGroup><ItemGroup><PackageReference Include="xunit.v3" Version="4.0.2"/><PackageReference Include="Shouldly" Version="4.3.0"/><Using Include="Xunit"/></ItemGroup></Project>'''
manifest={'source_sha256':{name:hashlib.sha256((folder/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in original},'variants':{}}
for name,variant in variants.items():
 directory=base/name;directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 for file,text in variant.items():(directory/file).write_text(text)
 (directory/'Mutation.csproj').write_text(project)
 manifest['variants'][name]={file:hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest() for file,text in variant.items()}
(base/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Prepared control plus',len(variants)-1,'single-purpose exact-source mutations.')
